item.title: Corner of Halifax Street and Kirkdale impossible to navigate safely because of hugely uneven pavement right on the edge of the road. sE 26, 15th October
item.description:
There is very little space to step onto the pavement from Halifax Street outside the piano shop. the pavement is hugely raised on one side and falls away alarmingly with a big raised lump of something by the building. It is a very cramped space because of the telecoms box there and bus stop. Getting through that narrow space with the pavement so raised and uneven makes it a massive bottleneck for pedestrians , and those with prams find it really hard to negotiate. Wheelchair access is practically impossible and my guide dog now refuses to take me through there, which is a first. he considers it too dangerous for us to even attempt. Patching won't help. It needs someone to really sort it out.
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Sections of pavement on Kirkdale from Mount Ash road subsiding where cables were put in years ago. SE26, 15th October
item.description:
For a section of Kirkdale from Mount Ash Road down to the bus stop more or less the pavement is very uneven , with raised bits and areas that dip in the middle where old cables were laid decades ago. the pavement is very uneven , becoming potholed and degraded and it's narrow. Where people leave their bins out there permanently. It is quite frightening to have to navigate the unevenness so near to the traffic . because a turned ankle could result in someone falling into the road. The whole section needs looking at with the bins removed so you can assess the whole picture.
Report on FixMyStreet
